name: CodePal
summary: AI app builder that turns ideas into production software.
description: CodePal presents itself as an AI app builder, with a CodePal Agent, in-app code edits and CodePal Cloud project hosting. Usage runs on credits. The free Starter plan includes daily credits, project limits and limited Agent use; Standard and Pro are paid tiers with monthly credits, rollover and private projects; Enterprise is custom.
features: Code snippet generation: Creates code based on input.
Bug detection: Identifies potential issues in code.
Supports various languages: Handles multiple programming languages.

howToUse.title: Open CodePal
howToUse.description: Go to CodePal, the AI app builder, describe the product you want and start free with no credit card. The Starter plan includes 2 daily credits, up to 30 per month, up to 50 projects and limited Agent use.

howToUse.title: Let the Agent build and edit
howToUse.description: Use the CodePal Agent so it ships software for production rather than demos, then make in-app code edits while the build runs.

howToUse.title: Host the project
howToUse.description: Host the project on CodePal Cloud, publish a live URL and sync with GitHub. Usage runs on credits; paid Standard and Pro tiers add monthly credits, rollover and private projects. Enterprise is custom.

features_fr: Génération d'extraits de code: crée du code en fonction de la saisie.
Détection de bugs: identifie les problèmes potentiels dans le code.
Simplification du code: refactorise le code complexe.
Prend en charge plusieurs langages: gère plusieurs langages de programmation.
